changelog:
🚀 new update v3.4.4!

- 🧠 command gallery: explore & import ready-made ai commands in one tap
- 🔄 github updates: fetch release notes & apk directly inside the app
- ⏱️ api timeout control: customize response wait time (10s–120s)
- ⚙️ trigger flexibility: use triggers without needing a preceding space
- 📱 ui polish: fixed edge-to-edge issues for modern android devices
- ⚡ better detection: improved accessibility logic for faster, reliable triggers
- 🛡️ improved stability: fixed rare crashes during background & network errors
- 🚀 performance tweaks: smoother and faster experience under heavy usage
- 🐛 bug fixes: general improvements and maintenance
